metric_scope: Exact precision and recall over each entry’s evaluated_kinds (component, deployable, interface, and capability for public sources; content for the non-source fixture), evidenced edges whose evidence paths are listed in oracle_files, and every coverage question/status. Other map output is outside the evaluated universe. Seven pinned public repositories and one checked-in non-source fixture are evaluated. A separate full-repository guard requires all 12 source service roots, all 12 primary Dockerfiles, and all 9 GitHub workflow files in microservices-demo; these guards are not included in the precision/recall denominator.
